# ResultantAI

> AI automation consultancy building production voice AI systems, workflow automation, and AI diligence and agent security audits for small and mid-market businesses. Founded by Chris Mott in Clayton, California.

## About

ResultantAI is an independent AI automation consultancy. It is not affiliated with Resultant (resultant.com), the Indianapolis technology and data firm formerly known as KSM Consulting.

Chris Mott founded ResultantAI in December 2022 after fifteen years in B2B go-to-market and revenue operations at companies including EVERFI and Metadata.io. He builds and operates AI automation systems in production for service businesses, agencies, and B2B companies. ResultantAI is a solo practice, so the person who scopes the work is the person who builds it.

Website: https://resultantai.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/chrismott1
Company: https://www.linkedin.com/company/resultantai

## Services

### Voice AI Agents
From $5,000 setup plus from $750/mo platform. Most builds land between $5,000 and $10,000 depending on integrations and call paths. Flat fee, quoted in writing before work starts, no hourly billing and no change orders.
AI phone systems built on Retell AI that handle inbound calls, qualify callers, book appointments, and route urgent situations to a human.
- https://resultantai.com/lp/voice-ai/

### HIPAA Voice AI
From $15,000 plus from $1,500/mo platform. For regulated environments, with a business associate agreement in place.
- https://resultantai.com/pricing/

### Agent Security Audit
$2,500 for one agent across every customer-facing channel at one location. $6,000 for up to three agents, or one agent across up to five locations. $750 per agent per quarter for optional ongoing regression testing.
Adversarial testing of a customer-facing AI agent someone else built. Tests escalation handling, information disclosure, unauthorized commitments, unauthorized actions, and inappropriate speech. Delivers a findings report with a vendor remediation list and one retest within 60 days. Explicitly excludes network penetration testing, source code review, and HIPAA attestation.
- https://resultantai.com/agent-security-audit/

### AI Diligence Audit
$4,497, 14 day delivery.
Determines what conclusion AI models reach about an organization when a lender, board member, grantor, or procurement officer researches it before a meeting.
- https://resultantai.com/aeo-geo-audit/

### Workflow Automation
Scoped per project. Make.com and n8n workflows that remove manual steps: ticket creation, invoice generation, CRM sync, follow-up sequences, reporting.
- https://resultantai.com/automation/

### Agency AI Systems
White-label automation and per-client AI cost attribution for marketing agencies.
- https://resultantai.com/lp/agency-automation/

### Ongoing Support
Optimize retainer $1,497/mo for one active system. Partner retainer $2,997/mo for multiple systems. Out-of-scope changes outside a retainer are billed at $150/hr.
- https://resultantai.com/pricing/

## Case Studies

Three engagements are documented with results the client confirmed.

- Beaver Pumice (mining and aggregate): ended $500/week in billing errors with digital truck ticketing and a QuickBooks integration. Payback in 5 weeks. https://resultantai.com/case-study-beaver-pumice
- Adleg Marketing: marketing audit time cut 97%, from 90 minutes to 2 minutes. https://resultantai.com/work/adleg/
- Jami Consulting: 3x qualified leads.

All case studies: https://resultantai.com/case-studies
